subject.title: fix(openclaw): prevent private state races during publication

question: Is the current test and Linux evidence sufficient to accept the new fail-closed POSIX and Windows filesystem boundary, or must native Windows and existing-root upgrade proof complete first?
rationale: The patch changes a security-sensitive, platform-dependent filesystem contract; automated tests cannot establish whether real Windows ACL behavior and existing installations match the modeled semantics.

options.title: Require platform and upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the PR in draft until a native Windows focused run and fresh-versus-existing-root validation demonstrate both the security boundary and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Accept current evidence
options.body: Merge after code review while explicitly accepting that Windows ACL and existing-root compatibility are supported primarily by modeled tests rather than current-head native proof.

recommendation.title: Require platform and upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR in draft until a native Windows focused run and fresh-versus-existing-root validation demonstrate both the security boundary and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member with the complete documented implementation and validation context for this private-file hardening series.
